entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'updatePixelScale'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: updatePixelScale is memoized solely by geometry and otherwise reads current refs; geometry changes already replace the subscription. Cleanup is the unsubscribe returned by geometry.subscribe. Evidence: step-19 SVG lifecycle7/7; projection pixel-density tests remain separate. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'asset'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Dialogue request identity is stableAssetId plus explicit retry. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useImperativeHandle has a missing dependency: 'snake'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: snake is derived only from immutable rig.kind; replacing rig recreates the imperative handle. Paint/reset own refs and the pose is reset by motion lifecycle. entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'view'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.

entries.message: The ref value 'request.current' will likely have changed by the time this effect cleanup function runs. If this ref points to a node rendered by React, copy 'request.current' to a variable inside the effect, and use that variable in the cleanup function.
entries.reason: request is a numeric generation counter, not a DOM ref. Cleanup must increment its latest value and mark live false so all outstanding requests are invalidated. Copying its value would defeat cancellation. Evidence: step19 Keeper lifecycle; acceptImage checks live and ticket equality before writes. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a complex expression in the dependency array. Extract it to a separate variable so it can be statically checked.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'target'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'viewer.returnFocus'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: The atmosphere layout effect marks sibling nodes of viewer.returnFocus, cleans the exact marked siblings, and reruns on scene, placementId or lift. Owner canvas keys the enclosing scene by grid+slot and each outer placement by id; public renderer also retains its outer placement by id. Inspection suspends Grid transport and scope changes clear inspection. Within this supported lifetime the returnFocus outer node is stable; media/editor child replacement does not replace it. Navigating another placement changes placementId; remounting its scene changes scene or ends scope. Independent source/caller review: DisplayModule.jsx198; OwnerSystemWorkflowCanvas.jsx298,313–360; useOwnerSystemWorkflowFocusViewer; PublishedDisplayModule.jsx71–79,225; GridProductionRenderer.jsx91,156. No separate browser run by reviewer; final shared verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'base'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: base contains only the four frame geometry values. All four base and frame primitives are explicit dependencies. The effect applies a new committedFrame first, never clamps authored viewId or preserveAuthoredLayout windows, and only clamps screen companion windows. Current initial/preview/compact flags are also explicit. Evidence: Current source reread; agent1 mini-app-window-boundary proof; companion-tool-viewport/run-06 3/3; our Text/Display6 and recovery1. Controls boundary re-review: hook body/dependencies unchanged; only the existing external-control above/below decision now uses the actual canvas clip top. Primary parent and independent_core_review traced clip host, camera projection and presentation exclusions; text-controls-boundary retains native four-case red/green, six current transfer/control cases and unchanged authored bytes. Final shared-source verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect contains a call to 'setFrame'. Without a list of dependencies, this can lead to an infinite chain of updates. To fix this, pass [avoidControls, viewId, compact, bounds, minimumHeight, frame] as a second argument to the useLayoutEffect Hook.
entries.reason: Companion-control avoidance deliberately runs after every committed layout because actual control rectangles can change without React object identity changes. It excludes authored viewId/compact/live-gesture/hidden windows and writes only if both measured bounds differ and React frame differs. The second guard makes fractional DOM rounding converge instead of rescheduling equal state. Evidence: Current source reread; companion-tool-viewport/run-06 3/3. Controls boundary re-review: hook body/dependencies unchanged; only the existing external-control above/below decision now uses the actual canvas clip top. Primary parent and independent_core_review traced clip host, camera projection and presentation exclusions; text-controls-boundary retains native four-case red/green, six current transfer/control cases and unchanged authored bytes. Final shared-source verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies: 'crop' and 'viewer'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'trigger'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: The animation effect captures the return trigger for one lift. PresentationBoardDefinitive creates {scope,trigger,phase} once at open; subsequent close/phase updates spread the existing object and preserve trigger. Scope/instance changes remove lift. Closing/reducedMotion cancel and replace requestAnimationFrame; latest.current supplies geometry/callback updates during the animation. A detached trigger is checked with isConnected before focus. A new trigger requires a new mounted lift. Independent source/caller review: PresentationBoardDefinitive.jsx54–70,276,305–309; DisplayModuleLift.jsx66–84. No separate browser run by reviewer; final shared verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has missing dependencies: 'instanceId' and 'profileAddress'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Behouden: `storedShortcut` is een snapshot bij mount. Profiel/restored revision begrenzen LocalWorkbenchSession, activatie begrenst WorkbenchSession en `id` begrenst OwnerDisplayInstance. `profileAddress` en `instanceId` wisselen niet binnen die levensduur. S: Runtime keys; D owner/Visitor/reload; R release. Bij toekomstige hergebruikte instance over profielen heen vervalt deze uitzondering.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has missing dependencies: 'controller.draft.geometry', 'index', 'initialPresentation', 'storedShortcut?.name', and 'storedShortcut?.open'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.

Een veranderde index of controller-render mag de gebruikerpositie/openstatus niet terugzetten. S: `useState(initial)` en `changeWindow`; D, U.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has missing dependencies: 'initial', 'initialPresentation', 'instanceId', and 'storedShortcut'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Behouden: `initialWindow` is de eerste herstelwaarde van dezelfde keyed instance; shortcut-cache is alleen initiële fallback. Latere positie/openstatus gaat via `changeWindow`. S: instance-lifetime; D, R.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'controller'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Behouden onder het bestaande controllercontract: de geregistreerde controller wordt vernieuwd bij generatie, gridselectie, placementselectie, verborgen placements, fout/clearError of lock. Profiel, store-scope en module-id staan vast onder dezelfde instance-key. De callable controllerhandelingen gebruiken die scope en de geselecteerde/generation-waarden; er is geen noodzaak iedere nieuw geconstrueerde controllerobjectidentiteit door te melden. S: controllerproducer en registratie; D release/lock, bestaande controllertests. Dit moet herzien worden als een nieuw controllerresultaat een zelfstandig veranderende waarde toevoegt.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a complex expression in the dependency array. Extract it to a separate variable so it can be statically checked.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'dialog'. Either include it or remove the dependency array. If 'setName' needs the current value of 'dialog', you can also switch to useReducer instead of useState and read 'dialog' in the reducer.
entries.reason: Form initialization belongs to dialog type/category ID/section ID. Updating the same dialog with a storage error must retain the typed name and focus; adding whole dialog would reset failed-save input. categoryDialogInitialName is only the initial value for that identity. Existing library-storage browser proves retained input and successful retry; new entity/type reinitializes.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has a missing dependency: 'stageSize'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Independently traced measureOwnerSystemWorkflowHeroArtboard and projectDisplayStageViewport. Hero reads width/height/contentScale; grid projection reads width/height and draft geometry. Those fields, worldCover and geometry are explicit dependencies. screenScale is applied later to pointer conversion. Provider object identity conveys no additional projected geometry. Null versus object invalidates width/height in actual provider. Independent stage-input review: reviews/final-core/stage-input-review.json. The production delta removes duplicate child scale inputs and an unused fallback; no hook body changed. The existing lift fixture failed equally with both before components; its native-coordinate repair and final joint verification remain separately required.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has unnecessary dependencies: 'authoringLocked', 'controller.draft.profileAddress', 'cropSession', 'grid.id', 'interactionDisabled', 'playback.swipe', 'playingGrids', 'suspended', and 'viewerOpen'. Either exclude them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: This object is deliberately an interaction epoch. currentPlacementContext is replaced every render; old placementTarget.isCurrent compares its captured epoch before every create/preview/attach/place request. Grid/profile, authoring/input lock, playing/swipe, suspended, viewer and crop changes must invalidate old requests. The imperative handle is refreshed each render; there is no secondary persisted model. Independent stage-input review: reviews/final-core/stage-input-review.json. The production delta removes duplicate child scale inputs and an unused fallback; no hook body changed. The existing lift fixture failed equally with both before components; its native-coordinate repair and final joint verification remain separately required.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'playback'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Effect observes authoringLocked true->false and updates its previous ref in the same layout pass. It calls that render's pause; useGridPlayback.pause reads current transport/drag/frame refs and latest onPause. Unrelated playback object recreation is neither an unlock event nor needed to make the current transition fresh. Independent stage-input review: reviews/final-core/stage-input-review.json. The production delta removes duplicate child scale inputs and an unused fallback; no hook body changed. The existing lift fixture failed equally with both before components; its native-coordinate repair and final joint verification remain separately required.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'playback'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Global key listener reads only playback.isMoving. Other controller/grid/crop/interaction/lock/target inputs are explicit; cleanup removes the exact callback before replacement/unmount. Independent stage-input review: reviews/final-core/stage-input-review.json. The production delta removes duplicate child scale inputs and an unused fallback; no hook body changed. The existing lift fixture failed equally with both before components; its native-coordinate repair and final joint verification remain separately required.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has missing dependencies: 'initialPresentation?.name' and 'readOnly'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.

Runtime session keys isolate profile/restored session and per-instance id. Production Visitor passes readOnly continuously and remounts by profile/documentId/revision. Therefore these are initialization/authority inputs, not mutable fields omitted from an update subscription. Independently re-read current hook and actual OwnerDisplayInstance/PublishedDisplayModule callers. Hook source span is byte-identical to the Stage-reviewed before-copy. Only line76 displayName fallback changed; no effect body, dependency, persistence key or authority lifetime changed. Independent review: continuation/reviews/final-core/display-name-legacy-alias-review.json.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has missing dependencies: 'documentGeometry' and 'initialPresentation?.window?.width'. Either include them or remove the dependency array. entries.reason: geometryKey serializes documentGeometry, so every effective geometry change recreates measure and its observer with current geometry. host/layoutMode also invalidate. Captured initial width is read only when current view is absent; current frame width otherwise wins. Owner initialWindow and Visitor publication lifetime were checked above. Hook source span is byte-identical to the Stage-reviewed before-copy. Only line76 displayName fallback changed; no effect body, dependency, persistence key or authority lifetime changed. Independent review: continuation/reviews/final-core/display-name-legacy-alias-review.json.

entries.reason: Exact emitted fields are displayName, boardPosition.left/top, view.frame.board.width/height. All five values and onWindowChange are dependencies. Object-null initialization changes the optional primitive values, so it also schedules emission. No additional object member affects the output. Independently re-read current hook and actual OwnerDisplayInstance/PublishedDisplayModule callers. Hook source span is byte-identical to the Stage-reviewed before-copy. Only line76 displayName fallback changed; no effect body, dependency, persistence key or authority lifetime changed. Independent review: continuation/reviews/final-core/display-name-legacy-alias-review.json.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has missing dependencies: 'initialShortcut' and 'readOnly'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'options'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: The validity effect uses options only to resolve the current placement DOM. Owner getElement wraps the same lifetime placementRefs map; its wrapper identity changes every render but its meaning does not. Owner entries/items invalidate when placements/assets change. Public findPlacementElement is stable and items/document scope invalidate publication/grid changes. Outer placement nodes remain keyed by id while media children change. Scope effect separately invalidates requests/session, and async open checks mounted, request, scope, connected source and membership. This retains this validity effect for existing callers, not arbitrary future getElement implementations. Independent source/caller review: useOwnerSystemWorkflowFocusViewer.js8–28,47–49; OwnerSystemWorkflowCanvas.jsx298,317,356; PublishedDisplayModule.jsx68–79; useDisplayInspection.js19–35,55–70. No separate browser run by reviewer; final shared verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has missing dependencies: 'options.enabled', 'options.playing', 'options.reducedMotion', 'options.suspended', 'reset', and 'startTransport'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: This layout effect synchronizes a committed rail/source change. Other play/enabled/suspend/reduced-motion transitions are handled by the separate mode effect. Source change invokes functions from that render. Evidence: Grid playback loop/pause/local-state test; not an assertion that every lifecycle race has dedicated coverage. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'reset'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Scope change resets current ref-owned transport/drag/frame and sets current grid from latest.current. Depending on per-render reset would reset on every render. Evidence: Grid playback scope and cleanup source paths; local Workbench switching evidence. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies: 'options', 'paint', 'pause', 'reset', 'setSwipe', 'startTransport', and 'stopTransport'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Mode effect lists all transition gates; transport helpers access shared refs/latest. onPause is called from the effect render when disabling, not by a stale scheduled callback. Evidence: Grid playback pause/reduced-motion tests; timer/transport cancellation source reviewed. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies: 'paint', 'startTransport', 'stopTransport', and 'synchronize'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Mount-scoped listeners and ResizeObserver call functions that operate on persistent refs/latest.current; cleanup cancels frame/transport and disconnects all listeners/observer. They must not reinstall every render. Evidence: Grid playback browser test plus source cleanup; mounted canvas ref replacement outside normal owner lifecycle not separately proven. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'swipe'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: The observer effect needs swipe only as the active/inactive gate. It measures viewportRef.current.clientWidth and writes width.current, which paint reads. In useGridPlayback both Owner canvas and published stage supply a stable mounted viewport ref; changing swipe ids/deltas does not change the observed viewport. Boolean(swipe) starts/stops the observer; viewportRef replacement rebinds it; cleanup disconnects. Pixel motion is painted through current/committed refs independently of observer subscription. Independent source/caller review: useGridPlayback.js -> useGridSwipe; OwnerSystemWorkflowCanvas.jsx; PublishedDisplayModule.jsx stageRef/trackRef. No separate browser run by reviewer; final shared verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a complex expression in the dependency array. Extract it to a separate variable so it can be statically checked.
entries.reason: Boolean(swipe) is the exact lifecycle predicate of the resize observer, not an approximation of swipe contents. Its only branch is if (!swipe) return; callback reads viewport width and paint, no swipe field. Converting to a named scalar would only aid static analysis. Same caller/ref lifetime and disconnect invariant as the adjacent missing-swipe entry. Independent source/caller review: useGridSwipe.js65–76; useGridPlayback.js. No separate browser run by reviewer; final shared verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has an unnecessary dependency: 'identityRevision'. Either exclude it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: identityRevision invalidates the memoized projection when the external identity cache changes without changing the history reference. The subscription still owns cache notifications and cleanup; removing this dependency would leave resolved names stale. On 2026-10-24 only the development fixture path was separated; the live cache invalidation contract is retained. Focused Activity browser and formatting tests recorded under runtime-boundaries-2026-10-24.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has a missing dependency: 'initialGridId'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: initialGridId is a mount/authority initializer, validated against the new session grids. Subsequent preference/layout updates must not recreate the Display session or reset its current Grid. Authority identity is explicitly profile, selected storage, shared activation-scoped store and moduleId; caller remounts on profile/Workbench activation. Parent traced Runtime/Display instance callers and authority creation; scope units and current local-workbenches/routing/Display reload coverage support those boundaries. No asynchronous initialGridId callback is retained.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has unnecessary dependencies: 'authority' and 'state.selectedGridId'. Either exclude them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: The empty object is the selection epoch. Authority replacement and selectedGridId transitions intentionally invalidate old selection actions even though the factory reads neither value. liveSelectionScope and mounted guards reject captured actions after a scope switch; available placement IDs and visibility are filtered from the current Grid. Removing either dependency revives selection in a different editor context. Parent reviewed actual guards and caller lifetimes; scoped late-writer and Library-drop lifecycle checks provide related behavioral evidence.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'clearGesture'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
